editorial.verdict: Best overall office chair for small spaces when you need all-day support without a bulky gaming-chair footprint.
editorial.description: A clean-lined chair with lumbar support that works in rooms where bulky gaming chairs feel wrong.
bestFor: All-day seating in shared living spaces
notFor: Shoppers hunting a budget chair under $200
Anyone who wants a headrest-heavy gaming look or extra-wide throne seating
Users who need fully removable armrests for an ultra-shallow desk tuck

review.summary: A clean-lined chair with lumbar support that works in rooms where bulky gaming chairs feel wrong.
